app.name: aMule Nuxt
app.daemonUnreachableFallback: check the host, port and password

common.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.subtitle: Manage your download queue
downloads.staleTitle: Showing the last queue that could be read
downloads.emptyDescription: Paste an eD2k or magnet link above to start downloading.
downloads.showRateOverTime: Show the transfer rate over time
downloads.removeQuestion: Remove {name} from the queue? aMule deletes the data downloaded so far.
downloads.noHashReported: aMule did not report a file hash for this download.
downloads.startNotRecorded: This download was already in the queue when this app first looked, so its start time is not known.

health.errorReason: aMule reported this file as erroneous.
health.searchingReason: Searching for sources. aMule asks the eD2k servers and Kad, which normally takes seconds but can take a few minutes for a rare file. If it stays like this: check that the link's file size and 32 character hash are exactly as published (a wrong hash creates a download that can never start), connect to more servers and to Kad, and consider that nobody may be sharing the file any more.
health.stalledReason: All sources for this file went offline. It will resume automatically if one comes back.
health.waitingReason: Queued at {count} source, waiting for a free upload slot. | Queued at {count} sources, waiting for a free upload slot.

addLinks.label: Add downloads (eD2k or magnet links)
addLinks.help: One ed2k:// or magnet: link per line. Paste as many as you like, in one go or a few at a time.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.subtitle: What this daemon is currently sending, and to whom
uploads.staleTitle: Showing the last uploads that could be read
uploads.emptyDescription: Clients appear here while they download from you.

shared.title: Shared files
shared.subtitle: Everything this daemon offers, with request and transfer details
shared.staleTitle: Showing the last list that could be read
shared.emptyDescription: aMule reports no files in your shared directories.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Search for files on the eD2k and Kad networks
search.tabsHelp: A new search opens its own tab and keeps the previous results. aMule itself holds one search at a time, so only the newest can be refreshed.
search.snapshotAt: snapshot from {time}, run it again for fresh sources
search.noResultsDescription: Try different keywords, or search another network.
search.idleDescription: Kad works without a server; a global eD2k search needs a connected server.

result.title: Search result
result.noHash: aMule reported no hash for this result.
result.noSourcesWarning: No source reported this file. Adding it creates a download that cannot start until someone sharing it comes online.

search.noneInGroup: Nothing in this group. Every result of this search is somewhere else.

servers.title: Servers
servers.emptyDescription: aMule's server list is empty. Add a server or update the list from a URL.

logs.title: aMule logs
logs.subtitle: View daemon activity logs
logs.emptyDescription: The aMule daemon has not logged anything yet.

appearance.title: Appearance and performance
appearance.glassHelp: Cards and rows blur whatever is behind them. Turning this off keeps them translucent but stops the blur, which is the biggest saving on a weak GPU or a long list.
appearance.storedNote: Stored in a cookie on this device, so the page is already rendered the right way before it reaches the browser. Motion is dropped automatically when the system asks for reduced motion.
appearance.languageHelp: The same languages aMule itself is translated into. Remembered on this device.

notifications.title: Download notifications
notifications.intro: The server watches the queue itself, so a download added from another machine, from amuleGUI, or by a link handler is announced here too - not only the ones started in this browser.
notifications.addedHelp: Anything joining the queue, wherever it came from.
notifications.completedHelp: Including the ones aMule moves to the incoming folder while you are away.
notifications.systemHelp: Raises an operating-system notification when this tab is not the one on screen. An in-app message is always shown.
notifications.backgroundIntro: A service worker can receive notifications from this server even when the app is closed. It has to be granted once per browser.
notifications.insecureDescription: Browsers only allow push over https, or over http on localhost. Notifications still work while a tab is open.
notifications.deniedTitle: Notifications are blocked for this site
notifications.deniedDescription: Allow them in the browser's site settings, then enable this again.
notifications.disabled: This browser will no longer be notified in the background

links.title: Open links with this app
links.intro: Register this page as the handler for eD2k and magnet links, so clicking such a link anywhere on this device opens it here and offers to add it to the queue.
links.insecureDescription: Browsers only allow this over https, or over http on localhost. Open the app that way to enable it.
links.note: The browser asks for confirmation the first time. Installed as an app (PWA) the same handlers are declared in the manifest, which also covers the operating system.

connection.title: Connection Information
connection.configDescription: Connection settings are configured via environment variables. See .env.example for details.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.subtitle: A language model that runs entirely in this browser and can operate aMule for you
assistant.placeholder: Ask about your downloads, or tell it what to do...
assistant.downloadNote: The model is downloaded once and cached by the browser. Nothing you type ever leaves this device.
assistant.unsupportedTitle: This browser cannot run a local model
assistant.unsupportedDescription: WebGPU is required. Chrome, Edge and Opera have it on desktop; Safari and Firefox are still adding it.
assistant.emptyDescription: Try: "what is downloading right now?" or "pause everything that has no sources".

selection.selectAll: Select everything that matches the filter
selection.totalsIntro: Everything below is the total across the file you picked. | Everything below is the total across the {count} files you picked.
selection.noLinks: None of the selected files reported an eD2k link, so there is nothing to copy.
selection.removeQuestion: Remove {count} download from the queue? aMule deletes the {size} downloaded so far. | Remove {count} downloads from the queue? aMule deletes the {size} downloaded so far.
